run_sweep_params: run the sweeper to submit SLURM jobs for all parameter combinations from a JSON file
build_command: build a shell command string from a game module path and parameter key-value pairs
write_sbatch: write an SLURM sbatch shell script with GPU, memory, time, and partition settings
get_opts: parse command-line arguments for the sweeper including params_path, job_name, partition, and n_gpus
prep_checkpointdir: prepare checkpoint directory paths by appending SLURM job IDs to avoid overwriting weights
